ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this was a metered ride from Ang Mo Kio Hub to Outram Park on 6 Sep 2026. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-04002, weight 1.0, unimpaired: 177 fixes at a 10 s cadence, no gaps, largest step 177.9 m) measures the trip at 22.40 km against the booked optimal of 13.0 km (EV-TRIP-04002). That is an excess of 9.4 km, 72.3% of optimal, so under POL-RD-01 a route deviation is established; the trace figure governs and the rounded trip-record copy agrees with it.

The driver's closure explanation is backed by a genuine artifact, not a bare assertion: LTA notice EV-ADVIS-04002-01 (weight 1.0) closes the CTE between the Bukit Timah Road entrance and the Chin Swee Road exit, all lanes, from 23:30 on 5 Sep to 05:00 on 6 Sep — the exact segment the booked route uses (the trip record's route_planned event) and inside the period the trace shows the vehicle reaching the city. That engages POL-RD-03, but the clause caps how far 'there was a closure' reaches: the shortest lawful alternative was 15.2 km, so the justified excess is 1.30 x (15.2 - 13.0) + 1.0 = 3.86 km, not the full 9.4 km. The rider's alternative argument that limb (c) is unmade because the derived block leaves intersects_route null is rejected: the trace is admitted and unimpaired, the endpoints are the same, and the closure artifact the clause reads is present, complete and covers the window, so the exoneration runs at the cap.

Because 3.86 km of the excess is excused, POL-RD-02 is recomputed against the closure-adjusted optimal: distance 13.0 + 3.86 = 16.86 km, duration 22.0 min (the booked 17 min scaled), giving a fare of 3.80 + 0.75 x 16.86 + 0.28 x 22.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 23.405. You were charged 29.52 (EV-FARE-04002, METERED). Refund = 29.52 - 23.405 = 6.115, rounded up to SGD 6.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis floor and well under the 90% full-refund share. The rider's claim of 12.00 is not supported, and the alternative figure of 10.45 is not payable because the closure exoneration does apply.

The unexcused balance is 5.54 km, about 32.9% of the adjusted optimal. It stays above the 20% establishment gate so the deviation stands, but it is below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so the deviation is not MATERIAL and the POL-RD-06 full-refund uplift and conduct referral are not engaged — the driver's profile shows no trailing-90-day pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 over completed_trips_90d 310), and lifetime counters such as prior_deviation_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01.

Nothing is added on top of the refund. The fare carries no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge (correctly, since the trip does not originate at an airport), so no POL-RD-09 pass-through correction arises and the anti-double-count rule bites. The chat log (EV-CHAT-04002) holds no rider detour instruction — no waypoint_hint, no road named — so POL-RD-04 excludes no distance and no driver compensation is payable. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match, the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps agree, the cited advisory is in the pool, and the refund is far below both the SGD 150.00 ceiling and charged_total, so the case is decided rather than escalated and there is no clause-mandated referral. The monetary effect (SGD 6.15) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold and executes on issue. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. On 16 Aug 2026 you booked trip TRP-04003 from Hougang Ave 1 to Marina Bay Financial Centre. The route the platform planned at booking was 13.5 km / 20 min. The GPS trace for this trip measures 17.6 km — an excess of 4.1 km, or 30.4% of the planned route — which is over both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (0.8 km and 20%). The fare charged was 25.08: base 3.80 + distance 13.20 (0.75 x 17.60 km) + time 7.28 (0.28 x 26 min) + 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no toll and no surcharge line.

WHY I CANNOT RULE ON THE MERITS. The only artifact that measures this trip's route, EV-GPS-04003, is impaired. It carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW: a single 450-second hole with no fixes at all, from 14:11:30 to 14:19:00, whose bounding fixes are 8,489.6 m apart in a straight line. That breaches POL-RD-07(a) (a gap over 90 s) and POL-RD-07(b) (a jump over 500 m), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the schema pre-pass. Several kilometres of the '17.6 km' figure are therefore not a track but one straight line drawn across the missing stretch.

Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone; it must be corroborated by a source independent of the trace. I checked every source that limb names and the bundle holds none. The chat log EV-CHAT-04003 is about the pickup only ('reached already, downstairs at the drop off' / 'ok 1 min'), contains no route admission, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-04003 has an empty erp_gantries array, so no charged gantry puts the vehicle on a corridor the planned route never uses. There is no counterparty statement (case.dispute.counterparty_statement is null). And trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6 km is, on EV-TRIP-04003's own admissibility note, 'the trace figure rounded to 1 dp' — the same measurement, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as not independent. The fare breakdown's billed distance is the same trace-derived figure and is excluded for the same reason.

THE OUTCOME. Under POL-RD-07(iii), where the trace is impaired and no independent corroboration exists, the claim is not sustained and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because this is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory and terminal: no amount issues, and the disputed 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. POL-RD-10(1) fires independently — the deciding fact (the 4.1 km excess) is carried by the impaired trace alone, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence ceiling is 0.6 (EV-GPS-04003, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW), which is below the 0.70 platform floor; bundle integrity, the mean across the bundle, is context only and is not the cap. POL-RD-13 confirms the result from the other direction: the absence of a traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-04003-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is a gap in the bundle and not the deciding defect here, but it supplies nothing that could corroborate the trace, and POL-RD-13 expressly leaves POL-RD-10(3) governing where the trace itself is impaired.

CLAIMS ANSWERED. Both advocates' impairment claims (driver claims 1 and 5 insofar as they describe the gap; rider claims 1 and 4) are accepted: the trace is impaired and no corroboration exists. Both sides' escalation claims (driver claim 3, rider claim 4) are accepted and are the basis of this ruling. Rider claim 5 (confidence floor engaged) is accepted. Rider claim 3 and driver claim 2 (rider's POL-RD-08 burden not discharged from an independent source) are accepted. The driver's point (driver claim 5) that driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 245, and that the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags may not be substituted for it, is correct; nothing in this ruling rests on that lifetime field (POL-GEN-01).

CLAIMS CONSIDERED AND NOT REACHED. The POL-RD-02 arithmetic advanced by rider claim 6 and driver claim 6 is correct as arithmetic — 25.08 less a recomputed fare of 20.325 = 4.755, rounded up to 4.80 — but it is not reached, because the deviation it depends on cannot be established on this trace. The rider's 6.00 request is a round figure not carried by the ledger; had the deviation been proved the policy figure would be 4.80, not 6.00. Materiality and POL-RD-06 (driver claim 5, rider claim 2): the excess is above the establishment gates but below the materiality gates of 8.0 km / 50%, and no pattern exists, so no conduct uplift or POL-RD-06(c) referral arises. Pass-through lines (driver claim 7, rider claim 7): the fare breakdown carries no ERP, toll, airport-surcharge or waiting-time line, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to act on and no standalone correction or billing-integrity referral is due. The rider's own profile (rider claim 8) adds no corroboration requirement: deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, both below the POL-RD-08 thresholds.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. The stretch that decides this case is the 450 seconds the trace is missing (14:11:30 to 14:19:00). A record-type item covering it would settle the dispute — a rider-side GPS export, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement for gantries on the corridor actually driven, or a driver statement — and a human reviewer will determine whether the missing stretch accounts for the extra distance.

Rider and driver: this dispute turns on one figure, and the record supplies it clearly.

What happened. The trip was booked at a fixed upfront price of $17.90 (EV-TRIP-04004, EV-FARE-04004). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-04004) shows the car covered 16.32 km against the 12.10 km route the platform priced at booking — an excess of 4.22 km, or 34.88%. That passes the establishment test in POL-RD-01 (over 0.8 km and over 20%), so a route deviation did occur. It does not pass the materiality limbs (8.0 km / 50%), so the deviation is established but not material. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is therefore not required by materiality, and in any event driver D-4102 has 0 deviation flags in the last 90 days over 280 completed trips — no pattern, and so no driver-conduct referral.

Why the refund is $6.50. Because this is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip, POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, the rider did not lose them to the detour, and none of them is refunded. What applies is POL-RD-11(a) — everything charged above the $17.90 quote and above the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. The ledger (EV-FARE-04004) charges $24.40, and carries no ERP gantry lines ($0.00), no airport surcharge ($0.00 — this trip ends in Pasir Ris, it does not originate at an airport) and no waiting fee ($0.00). So $24.40 − $17.90 − $0.00 = $6.50, which is already a multiple of 5 cents. That is the whole contested amount, so the rider is entirely right and the outcome is FULL_REFUND.

The points each side raised, answered together:
- The trace is sound. POL-RD-07 impairs a trace only on a gap over 90 s, a step over 500 m or a cadence over 30 s; this trace has 164 fixes at a 10 s cadence, a longest gap of 10 s and a longest step of 150.1 m. None of limbs (a)–(c) fires, so the deviation stands on this trip's own measurement and no POL-RD-10(3) hold-back applies.
- No rider instruction caused the detour. The chat log (EV-CHAT-04004) holds two pickup-logistics messages, neither from the rider naming a place or road and neither carrying a waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run and no distance is excluded.
- The driver's traffic position carries no weight. The traffic advisory for this trip (EV-ADVIS-04004-01) is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — disclosed by both sides. The driver's statement names no advisory and says only that he followed the navigation. Under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction; POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the deviation stands at the measured figure.
- The counterparty statement ('I just follow the navigation; the fare is calculated by the app') cites no evidence and concedes nothing against the driver's interest, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight against the trace and nothing on the record is decided by it.
- No billing-integrity failure: distance fare 12.24 (0.75 × 16.32 km), time fare 7.56 (0.28 × 27 min), base fare 3.80 and platform fee 0.80 all reconcile to the trace and the rate card, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral fires.
- No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: trip identifiers match (TRP-04004), timestamps are causally ordered, the trace is unimpaired, and the $6.50 remedy is far below the $150.00 ceiling.

No clause in this case produces a referral. The monetary effect of $6.50 is at or below the $8.00 execution threshold, so the refund is executed automatically on issue. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

Both of you should read this the same way: the distance and time charges for the ride stand, the SGD 2.00 CTE ERP line comes off, and SGD 2.00 is refunded to the rider.

What the trip shows. This is trip TRP-04006; the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown all carry that identifier and agree on the timestamps. The platform's booked optimal route from Ang Mo Kio Ave 6 to Novena Medical Center was 8.7 km (EV-TRIP-04006). The governing distance is the GPS trace figure of 9.84 km (EV-GPS-04006), not the rounded 9.8 km convenience copy on the trip record, because POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern. Excess = 9.84 - 8.7 = 1.14 km, which is 13.1% of optimal. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only when the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. The 13.1% fails the percentage test, so no route deviation is established, however the morning felt and whatever a usual fare has been.

What follows for the contested amount. Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-02's optimal-route recomputation is never reached, and the distance charge (9.84 km x SGD 0.75 = SGD 7.38) and time charge (17 min x SGD 0.28 = SGD 4.76) stand as billed. The ledger reconciles to the cent: 3.80 base + 7.38 + 4.76 + 2.00 ERP + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 18.74 charged.

The one line that cannot stand. The SGD 2.00 ERP charge for the CTE (southbound) gantry after Braddell Road, charged at 08:33, is for a gantry the trace never passes: the closest of the 104 fixes, at 08:34:30, is 1,843.93 m from the gantry's recorded coordinates, far outside the 250 m radius POL-RD-09(4) treats as a crossing. The booking route itemised ERP of SGD 0.00, and the fare block itself marks the line as off the optimal route (SGD 2.00 off-optimal against SGD 0.00 on-optimal). Under POL-RD-09(4) a charge for a gantry the trace never crosses is a billing-integrity failure, refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists — and POL-RD-01 expressly preserves that limb where neither establishment test is met. Because no POL-RD-02 refund runs, nothing is double-counted (POL-RD-09(1)); and POL-RD-10(8) expressly excepts a line refunded under POL-RD-09(4), so this case is ruled rather than held.

The accounts of both parties. The driver's statement that he went by Upper Thomson and Thomson Road and never used the CTE agrees with the planned corridor on the record (Ang Mo Kio Ave 6, Ave 1, Marymount Rd, Thomson Rd, Sinaran Dr) and with the trace, which never approaches the gantry; it is consistent with the ruling but is not what carries it. The rider's account of a loop round Yio Chu Kang and '4-5 km extra' is supported by no artifact in the bundle and is contradicted by the only measurement on file (1.14 km, not 4-5 km); under POL-RD-08 an assertion unsupported by evidence carries no weight. The driver's submission that the rider's claim be met with NO_ACTION is rejected so far as it would leave the ERP line in place: the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND on the rider's contested amount.

Points checked and not used as grounds. No traffic advisory exists in the bundle — EV-ADVIS-04006-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — but neither party asserts an external traffic cause or cites that identifier, so under POL-RD-13 there is nothing to test against it, POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable, and no POL-RD-10(5) escalation arises. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 104 fixes at a 10 s cadence, largest interval 10 s, largest straight-line step 114.0 m, highest implied speed 41.0 km/h. So the gap consequences of POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) do not engage, and the absence of any CTE crossing is a real absence rather than a hole in the record. POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is not triggered, the deviation being neither established nor material, and consulted anyway it returns nothing: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 295 completed trips in 90 days, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The remaining profile fields mentioned on both sides (rating, lifetime_trips, prior_deviation_flags, prior_disputes_filed) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground nothing here. POL-RD-04's compensation limb is not available: the billed distance (9.84 km) is not less than the trace distance, so there is no unbilled distance to pay for, and driver_compensation_sgd is null.

Amount and confidence. Contested SGD 6.00; refunded SGD 2.00, being the CTE ERP correction alone. Confidence is 0.9: the artifacts the ruling rests on — EV-GPS-04006, EV-TRIP-04006 and EV-FARE-04006 — all carry weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is nowhere near. The monetary effect (SGD 2.00) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so under POL-GEN-05 it executes automatically on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The line is refunded in full as a standalone correction and is recorded here for billing-integrity review.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This is an upfront-quoted RYDE_X trip (TRP-04005): Rider R-1846 booked Causeway Point to Ang Mo Kio Hub for a fixed fare of SGD 22.25 (EV-FARE-04005 quoted_fare_sgd 22.25; distance_charged_km 14.20; EV-TRIP-04005 booked optimal 14.20 km, 25 min). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-04005) records 20.57 km driven, an excess of 6.37 km or 44.86% over the booked route, which establishes a route deviation under POL-RD-01.

The deviation is the rider's own request. MSG-04005-003 (EV-CHAT-04005), sent by the rider at 15:59:50, asks the driver to stop at Northpoint first to collect a cake; the platform resolved that message's waypoint_hint to Northpoint City (1.4289, 103.8357), and the trace's nearest fix passes 55.0 m away, inside POL-RD-04's 200 m corroboration test. The rider does not dispute the request in her statement. POL-RD-04 therefore excludes the detour excess from any deviation charge against the driver.

Because the fare was fixed at booking, POL-RD-11 governs the rider's side: she is already whole on distance and time, POL-RD-02 does not run, and she owes nothing further. charged_total is 22.25, equal to the quote, so charged_over_quote is 0.00; there are no ERP, toll, airport-surcharge or waiting-time lines. The rider's payment state stands unchanged, and the driver's request for SGD 6.00 is not charged to her.

What remains is the driver's compensation under POL-RD-04. He was billed for 14.20 km but drove 20.57 km, a shortfall of 6.37 km, above the 1.0 km trigger. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre: 6.37 x 0.75 = SGD 4.7775, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 4.80, within the SGD 15.00 cap. The SGD 6.00 originally claimed corresponds to no line of the fare breakdown and to no formula in the policy. Under POL-GEN-03 this is platform/fee-funded driver compensation (driver_compensation_sgd), not a charge on the rider, and on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure. The monetary effect (SGD 4.80) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes on issue.

No escalation applies. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07 (195 fixes at a 10 s cadence, no gaps, largest step 216.7 m, highest speed 78.0 km/h). Trip identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown. No exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing artifact: EV-ADVIS-04005-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0, but the driver asserts no external traffic cause and POL-RD-03 is not invoked, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor.

On the POL-RD-06 check: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 330 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no conduct referral arises; the deviation is also not material (6.37 km is under 8.0 km and 44.86% is under 50%), and no billing-integrity referral arises because there is no unmatched charge line. The rider's point that the driver's filing narrative cites no evidence ID is noted but does not change the outcome: the driver's brief and the rider's own artifacts establish the facts, and no finding rests on the narrative alone.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: the route-deviation claim is upheld and the full contested fare of SGD 27.50 is refunded to the rider.

ROUTE. The governing actual distance is the GPS trace figure, 18.96 km (EV-GPS-04009); POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern and forbids citing the rounded 19.0 km convenience copy on the trip record for the threshold test. The booked optimal route is 10.3 km (EV-TRIP-04009), so the excess is 8.66 km — 84.1% of the optimal route. That clears both establishment tests (over 20% and over 0.8 km) and both materiality tests (over 50% and over 8.0 km).

TRACE INTEGRITY. The trace is impaired at schema level: it carries issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.85 (a 70-second gap from 23:16:50 to 23:18:00 just after the trip started, bounding fixes 194.6 m apart). The impairment is disclosed, and the finding survives it: the trace meets none of the policy-level limbs in POL-RD-07 (gap over 90 s, jump over 500 m, sustained interval over 30 s), so it is down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only and remains fit to establish the deviation without independent corroboration.

DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver's account that he used the expressway at night because it is faster is an external-cause assertion with no record behind it. The only traffic-advisory identifier in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-04009-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-13, the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; no advisory was on file and that explanation is discarded. No rider-requested detour arises either — there is no chat log for the trip (EV-CHAT-04009, MISSING at weight 0.0), so POL-RD-04 cannot be run — and no POL-RD-05 amendment or POL-RD-12 pooled itinerary applies.

MONEY. The fare model is METERED with surge_multiplier 1.0, read from the fare_breakdown, so POL-RD-02 applies. On the booked optimal route the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 × 10.3 + 0.28 × 17) × 1.0 + 0.80 = SGD 17.085, against a charged_total of SGD 27.50 — a POL-RD-02 partial refund of SGD 10.415, rounded up to SGD 10.45 (37.9% of the amount charged).

UPLIFT. The driver profile records deviation_flags_90d of 4 against completed_trips_90d of 380, so the repeat-deviation pattern in POL-RD-06 is established on the citable trailing-window fields. Because this deviation is material and substantiated on this trip's own evidence, POL-RD-06(b) lifts the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial of SGD 10.45 to a FULL_REFUND of the charged_total, SGD 27.50; the two figures are stated side by side so the size of the uplift is auditable. There are no ERP or surcharge pass-through lines to carve out (all zero), so the whole contested amount is refunded.

REFERRAL. The same pattern requires the case to go to driver-conduct review under POL-RD-06(c). That is a referral riding with the money ruling, not an escalation, and it does not delay the payment.

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. The deciding fact — the excess distance — rests on the single trace at weight 0.85, so confidence is capped at 0.85 under POL-GEN-02(2), above the 0.70 escalation floor. The refund of SGD 27.50 exceeds the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it is issued but held for release by a human reviewer under POL-GEN-05.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Both sides largely agree on the arithmetic, and on this record they are right. Your trip TRP-04011 (Compass One to Junction 8) was booked against an optimal route of 10.4 km / 19 min. The GPS trace EV-GPS-04011 measures the distance actually driven at 13.92 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events — an excess of 3.52 km, or 33.85% of the booked route. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL: 33.85% is below the 50% gate and 3.52 km is below the 8.0 km gate, so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered and the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) does not apply. The trace is likewise not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 158 fixes at a 10-second cadence, largest gap 10 seconds, largest step 108.4 m — so the measurement stands on the trace alone and needs no corroboration. The driver's explanation ('I followed the navigation app') does not move the figure: the bundle's only advisory, EV-ADVIS-04011-01, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, that clause is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 the assertion reduces nothing and supplies no amended optimal. No refund is excluded for a rider-requested detour: the chat log holds two messages, neither a detour request, neither naming a road, neither carrying a waypoint_hint, so the POL-RD-04 test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable. No pickup or dropoff was amended (both amendment timestamps null), so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-quote and the booked optimal of 10.4 km / 19 min stands. The refund is therefore arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and because the fare is METERED (quoted_fare_sgd null) POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 10.4 km + 0.28 x 19 min) x 1.0 surge, the multiplier read from EV-FARE-04011, + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 surcharge + 0.00 waiting fee - 0.00 promo = 17.72. Refund = charged_total 22.32 - 17.72 = 4.60, above the 0.50 de minimis floor and 20.6% of the charge, well short of the 90% that would make it a full refund. No ERP gantry, toll or surcharge was charged, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top and nothing is counted twice. The rider's request for $6 is a round-figure estimate rather than a measured figure; the measured entitlement is SGD 4.60 and that is the sum awarded. No referral fires: there is no material deviation or repeat pattern for POL-RD-06(c), and no billing-integrity failure for POL-RD-09(4). Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 4.60 to the rider. That amount is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
